articles.title: PGR pede que Flávio Bolsonaro seja ouvido por calúnia contra Lula
articles.summary: The Attorney General's Office requested that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro be questioned in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula.

articles.title: "Melhor arma que um país pode ter é alimento", diz Lula
articles.summary: President Lula announced R$ 97.7 billion in credits for family farmers during the launch of the 2026/2027 Agricultural Plan and emphasized the importance of food sovereignty.
